def: NVIDIA's topology-aware library of collective operations, such as all-reduce, all-gather, reduce-scatter and all-to-all, plus point-to-point send and receive between GPUs.
practice: The usual GPU backend of PyTorch's distributed package on NVIDIA hardware, running over NVLink, PCIe, InfiniBand or sockets; a stalled collective, often from one failing GPU, surfaces as an NCCL timeout.
